overview: ACA Health Insurance Inbound Calls are consumers who see an offer and dial in themselves, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Reach consumers shopping Affordable Care Act marketplace plans and connect them with a licensed health agent.

ACA shoppers often have questions that are easier to answer by phone than through a form, such as whether they qualify for a subsidy, which doctors are in network, or whether a life event opens a Special Enrollment Period. Inbound calls capture that preference: the consumer sees a health coverage offer, chooses to dial in, and reaches a licensed agent ready to explain plan options. For agencies staffed with licensed health agents, an inbound call is often the fastest path from first contact to a completed enrollment, provided all contact is TCPA-consented and free of government-affiliation or guaranteed-approval claims.

This product is suited to insurance businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of aca health insurance consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Adults aged 18 to 64 who are uninsured, losing coverage, or shopping the marketplace during an enrollment window. The strongest segments are consumers experiencing a qualifying life event, self-employed individuals, part-time and gig workers without employer coverage, and households likely to qualify for premium tax credits based on income.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for aca or marketplace health plans; currently uninsured and seeking coverage options; lost or losing employer-sponsored insurance; shopping during open enrollment or a special enrollment period.
howGenerated: Calls are generated through call-only and click-to-call performance campaigns targeting searches such as "ACA health insurance" and "affordable care act plans", alongside social and comparison placements. Every source is tracked, so call quality can be traced back to the campaign that produced it.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard aca health insurance criteria include: located in a state the agent is licensed to sell in; age 18 or older and the decision maker for the household plan; not currently enrolled in medicare or medicaid; uninsured or seeking to change existing marketplace coverage; enrolling within open enrollment or a valid special enrollment period; provided tcpa consent to be contacted about health coverage.
delivery: Calls are routed to your sales line in real time by state or ZIP, schedule and agent availability, with concurrency limits and daily caps set to your capacity. Call tracking and recording are available for quality control.

faq.q: Are ACA consumers contacted in a compliant way?
faq.a: Yes. Every consumer provides TCPA consent to be contacted about health coverage, and consumers are connected only with licensed health agents. Programs avoid any suggestion of government affiliation or guaranteed approval.

faq.q: Can programs run outside Open Enrollment?
faq.a: Yes. In addition to Open Enrollment, campaigns can target consumers who qualify for a Special Enrollment Period after events such as losing coverage, moving, marriage or a new child, keeping demand active year-round.

faq.q: Can consumers be filtered by state and eligibility?
faq.a: Yes. Delivery can be filtered to the states where your agents hold a license and screened for likely subsidy eligibility and enrollment status, so you receive consumers you can actually help enroll.
